== Description ==
Stream team [[Dan Tartaglione]] and [[Garrett Larson]] at the stream desk, 24 October, at the [[2026 World Championship]] (Hyatt Regency Bloomington, Bloomington, Minnesota).

== Source and credit ==
Photograph from [https://drive.google.com/file/d/1oNaVYSQy5hdpecq6LXrqf12WGWMw-wgN/view Stream Team.jpg], in the shared Worlds 2026 Photos & Videos album ([https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1yEnw5u2fcKsynieu6KP4DVFEK-IwGuHL folder]).

== Changes ==
Full frame retained. Encoded orientation normalized and longest edge limited to 2,400 pixels without upscaling; camera metadata removed.
